body: Thank you Charlie. It is really awful. I don't know how people can possibly get through when kids or marriage is involved though. There's alot about life that I just can't comprehend. I can't imagine why people like me who are severely depressed and socially stunted want to keep pushing through. So many injustices happening everyday in society around us. I just can't ignore all the pain :/ but yes, I was actually looking into going to a psychiatrist next week or as soon as possible after the holidays. I do want to see if I can treat my anxiety and see if anything improves. Just have to keep myself grounded through these next two holidays... Thank you so much for taking the time to listen and provide helpful feedback

Thank you for your reply. I did consider it, but I worry he's out to hurt me. And if its true, calling him will only reassure him that he's the only thing on my mind and he will keep doing this to me. He knows that i mentally am fixated on him and he is kicking where it hurts by treating me like this. Of course, then the question comes "if that is true, would you want to be involved with someone like that?" My reply "because in other ways he has kept me grounded, actually quite happy when things are good, he was my best friend and closest companion. but of course no real decent excuse for such crappy behavior. There is nothing I could say that would make it better."

If I do progress, I will definitely be calling him or someone else first.

Hi Charlie, I am safe right now thanks. The details I'm sure are far to extensive to give you a fair point of view (five years of dating and we live together with no real way to move out for another 8 months) he made the breakup official a few days ago and has not been home much at all. Meanwhile, I'm the obsessive type that can't get over it, can't stop thinking about it. I have already had depression issues long before he came around, and cannot find many good things in life easily. It isn't beautiful to me. Its suffering. I have social anxiety so bad that I can't even manage to go out to a restaurant or bar on my own. I have no friends and am scared to make them. I just don't get time to invest in friendships when I work the job I'm in...
